name: manual_fc146b
claim: A fallback branch that CI never takes is untested and usually wrong: when a test prefers an installed package and falls back to a source checkout, compare how CI installs and invokes, make the branch decision a pure function, and unit-test both outcomes without a subprocess.

decisions.notes: Three oramasys tests failed only in a source checkout. CI always pip-installs the package, so the cross-process helper's fallback, which dropped PYTHONPATH and never supplied the source root, was never taken there. pytest's pythonpath setting configures only the test process, so a child interpreter inherits no path to the checkout.
